result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 225 passed and was published as `80fbb3b`. I planned round 226: the first part of CALM-1 (CALM-1a) from Saba's "Calm Studio" request. I didn't touch app source; the store's `git status` is clean.

**Backlog changes from C's round 225 evidence**
- C passed all 10 rows with real browser checks and found no bugs.
- The determinism work for the perf reports (PERF-HARNESS-SHARED-LIB-b-i) is done.
- Three findings are closed, each by a named C row: C-R224-01, A-R224-REVIEW-TENTHS-NAN and C-R224-02.
- New Low, B-R225-BACK-TO-START-KEY: the "Back to start" tooltip says "(0)", but no key 0 exists; the real key is Home. It gets fixed in round 227.
- R77-BUTTON-SHORTCUT-SUPERSET stays open. The design review said CALM-1 would close it, but it is a different issue.

**Round 226 task (CALM-1a), baseline `80fbb3b`**
- **What A builds:**
  - a shortcut sheet over Studio that opens with `?`, closes with Esc, and has a search box;
  - one source file, `shortcuts.ts`, listing 43 shortcuts. I matched each one to a line of code, and checked the two that rely on browser behaviour (Shift+wheel, PageUp/PageDown) in Chromium;
  - a quiet "Shortcuts ?" button in the footer;
  - removal of the permanent 19-key line. That shrinks the footer from 69 to 49 px and gives the timeline 20 px more height;
  - the drag hint (lane move) moves into the same footer row as the selected-clip line, replacing it during a drag.
- **Scope:** A may edit 4 existing files and create 5 new ones. The other 1,073 tracked files are hash-locked, including `ui/Modal.tsx` and the protected login/purchase files.
- **Test clashes found ahead of time:** I ran the app's tests on a scratch copy with the change applied. Only two existing tests fail, WSU1 and UC12, and A is allowed to edit them.
- **What C checks:** before/after sizes against the measurements I saved, each of the 43 shortcuts actually pressed in the browser, cases where `?` must not open the sheet (text fields, Export open, held key, other keyboard layouts), accessibility and contrast, the screen-text budget, the Ableton comparison, the sign-in guard and an export smoke check.

**Why CALM-1 is split in two:** putting the keys into every button tooltip turns 18 more existing tests red, across 7 more files. That part is round 227 (CALM-1b). Nothing from Saba's request was dropped. Then CALM-2 is round 228 and CALM-3 is round 229, unless the regression round due on or after 2026-10-30 comes first.

**Ableton reference:** I read the Live 12 manual directly (ch. 42, 2.2.2 Info View, 3.2 Status Bar). The files the design review cited are not on this machine. The listed deviation: in Live, `?` toggles the Info View; in CZABA it opens the shortcut sheet.

**Other outputs**
- "Why we missed it" is in the task (§1.1), and the new lesson L39 says persistent screen text needs a budget row.
- The sheet is the third dialog with its own hand-written focus handling. I filed a non-blocking architecture review request for root (`b-round-225-checkpoint-request.md`). CALM-1a does not wait for it.
- The advisor was available and I used it twice. Its final review added: a held `?` must open the sheet only once, a contrast row for the footer button, a check that the ⌘/⌥ characters render (with fallback text decided in advance), and a rule for the widest sheet row.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- `current-task.md` (round 226)
